verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for bulk operations, such as selecting many incidents or alerts and updating, resolving or reassigning them in one action, via the UI, API or MCP server. Alert grouping and deduplication, per-incident workflows, and migration imports are adjacent features, not user-driven bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
